meta.title: Difficulty range 1–3 and distance chips (≤ 50 / ≤ 100 / ≤ 150 / Any)
meta.requirement: AC5 — difficulty range, distance options, default Any
precondition: Guest, location granted + mock at Tashkent centre
steps: Note the Distance chip before touching it
Distance ≤ 50 km → Apply; then ≤ 100; then ≤ 150; then Any (each Apply)
expected: Untouched Distance chip is the default state (value Any) — UI tree + screenshot
Difficulty chip reads 'Difficulty 1–3'; header = API total for difficultyMin=1&difficultyMax=3; event explore_filters_applied {difficultyMin: 1, difficultyMax: 3} — UI tree + API response + QA event
For each of 50 / 100 / 150 the chip reads '≤ N km' and the header equals the API total for maxDistanceKm=N (a place exactly on N km stays in); Any returns 71 — UI tree + API response + QA event maxKm

caption.expected: Untouched Distance chip is the default state (value Any)

done: Guest, location granted + mock at Tashkent centre · Explore loaded, no filter

3.observed: 50: chip '≤ 50 km', header 6, api 6, event maxKm 50; 100: chip '≤ 100 km', header 48, api 48, event maxKm 100; 150: chip '≤ 150 km', header 58, api 58, event maxKm 150; Any: chip 'Distance', header 61, api 61, event maxKm None
